correctness.rationale: Uniform random batch means have centered zero-sum exchangeable covariances. Both fresh and frozen random partitions have the same unconditional epoch-noise variance, and frozen conditional centering kills all cross-epoch covariance. Exact four-label partition enumeration gives two zero-noise partitions and one Bernoulli partition, proving distinct stationary mixture and i.i.d. three-digit autoregression. For \(0<r<1/3\) disjoint IFS images and Bernoulli entropy establish dimensions; at \(r=1/3\) ternary digit frequencies prove singularity without atoms and full interval support. Direct cumulant formulas give \(\kappa_4=0\) and nonzero \(\kappa_6\). Rebuilt standalone checker from current package path yielded VERIFY_OK 236; no finite enumeration was used as infinite proof. The exact-local-solve exception \(r=0\) is explicitly excluded from singularity statements.

value.rationale: The 2026 parent identifies fresh repartitioning as not covered by fixed-partition theory. This mathematically natural minimal four-data, batch-size-two example proves that every finite-epoch second moment, limiting MSE and even Gaussian fourth kurtosis can conceal a dramatic atom-versus-singular law distinction. The exact ternary critical step makes the counterexample a calibration benchmark for uncertainty quantification of minibatch reshuffling; the result neither claims a generic convergence theorem nor recomputes a known table.
